name: Sudama Chhatravrtti Yojana
benefit: The scholarship amount for male students: Rs. 5000/- annually. The Scholarship amount for female students: Rs. 5250/- annually.
eligibility_rules: The parent's annual Income should not be more than Rs. 1 Lakhs. Family Should belong to BPL category. Students should secure above 60% marks in 10th class and currently studying in 11th & 12th class and living in the hostel. Students should belong to the General Category.
documents_required: authority (electricity bill, water connection bill, etc.).Aadhar card. Bank Account Details. Income certificate of parents.class 9th and 10th
how_to_apply: Mode: Online Applicant students have to contact their educational institution. The profile of the students is entered on the education portal www.shikshaportal.mp.gov.in by the teacher of the educational institution as per the record/certificate provided by the student. Fill out the application form and attach the required documents. Submit.
